independence.statement: This was a second independent audit derived directly from the English catalogues, context sidecars, target bytes, locale guidance and existing zh-CN terminology. The auditor is not the translator, did not edit any catalogue or generated file, and did not read or copy another new zh-CN completion audit receipt.

scope.requirement: All values in the nine new zh-CN files, not a sample; exact English/target/context key sets and order; semantic accuracy, idiom, register, glossary, ICU/CLDR, typography, pseudo-localization, English leakage and static overflow.

evidence.semantic_and_glossary: Read all 134 English/target/context triples. Compared high-visibility wording with existing zh-CN catalogues, including 数据分析, 后台任务, 分叉, 叙述/回复, 会话 versus 对话, 凭据, 工具审批, Canvas and provider terminology. Six repeated exact-English values with multiple existing Chinese renderings were examined in context; none established a defect in these new values. Eight namespaces have no semantic/register/glossary finding; the sidebar finding is recorded below.
evidence.key_set_and_order: Derived from parsed bytes at the pinned commit: English=43+34+30+11+5+4+4+2+1=134 keys. Every namespace has identical English, target and context key sets and identical English/target/context insertion order; no missing, extra or duplicate scoped key was found.

repository_checks.actual_result: exit 0; 43 tests, 43 pass, 0 fail. zh-CN passed non-empty, unique-key, complete-key, known-key, real-ICU-placeholder and not-English-stub checks.
exit 0; context-parity ok (131 pre-existing allowed gaps in 4 namespaces); keys.gen.ts byte-identical to fresh generation.

icu_and_cldr.command: Scoped Node probe using @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser, intl-messageformat and Intl.PluralRules against all nine files.
icu_and_cldr.actual_result: 134 keys; 17 English argument usages exactly matched target argument name, type, order and number skeleton; 1 plural node and 1 select node; 0 failures. Select options pin/unpin/other rendered separately. Intl.PluralRules('zh-CN').resolvedOptions().pluralCategories=["other"]; 0, 1, 2, 5 and 1234 all selected other.

evidence.pseudo_localization: The same scoped Node probe doubled every non-whitespace literal code point, wrapped literal segments in ⟦⟧, preserved ICU AST nodes, and formatted every message plus plural/select variants through intl-messageformat. Actual result: 139 pseudo renders, 0 failures; no unresolved braces, replacement characters, undefined or NaN. Sample: ⟦立立即即停停止止⟧1234⟦个个会会话话⟧. This is parser/formatter stress evidence, not rendered-layout evidence.
evidence.static_overflow: Measured formatted strings with CJK/full-width characters=2 cells and ASCII=1, using count/max=1234, action=other and representative NAME/QUERY/TITLE. Nine of 134 targets were wider than English. Largest ratio: ui.chat.run_details.jobs 4->8 cells (后台任务); largest absolute increase was +4 cells. Other increases were ui.common.file_actions.open_folder 11->14, ui.common.viewer.opening 8->10, and six labels by +1 cell. No material static overflow finding: the largest ratios remain very short absolute labels, and 后台任务 matches the background-jobs context. Sidecars provide prose length guidance but no numeric maxCells for this scope. Real wrapping/truncation remains unverified.
evidence.typography: Scoped scans found 0 您, 0 ASCII '...', 0 single Chinese ellipsis, 0 unexpected target-only final full stops, 0 no-trailing-punctuation violations and 0 CJK/Latin-or-digit separating-space hits. Chinese ellipses are ……. ASCII colon+space remains only in the two monospace diagnostic lines supplement.details.attempts/model and is accepted in that technical context. One polite 请 occurrence is the MINOR finding; 请求 in stop copy is a noun, not polite address.
evidence.english_leakage: Parsed literal-node scan covered 147 target literal nodes. Eight nodes contained Latin runs; unique runs were exactly Canvas, Esc, Finder, HTML, ID, Local Operator and token. No untranslated English prose and no byte-identical English stub was found.
evidence.rtl: Not applicable: zh-CN is left-to-right; no RTL or bidi claim is made.
evidence.limitations: Catalogue and formatter audit only. No rendered frames, real-app geometry, native activation, release eligibility or visual-fit evidence is claimed; the programme's later real-app frame gate remains required.

allowed_english_tokens.Local Operator: Product name; glossary requires exact English spelling (ui.chat.sidebar.search.names_only).
allowed_english_tokens.ID: Technical identifier abbreviation in session ID (ui.chat.sidebar.row_menu.copy_id).
allowed_english_tokens.token: LLM token; zh-CN style guide explicitly keeps token rather than 词元 (ui.chat.pickers.fast.premium_acknowledgement).
allowed_english_tokens.Canvas: Named product pane; context explicitly requires English (ui.chat.canonical.supplement.file_actions.open_in_canvas and ui.common.file_actions.show_in_canvas).
allowed_english_tokens.Finder: Apple product name; context explicitly requires English (ui.chat.canonical.supplement.file_actions.reveal_in_finder).
allowed_english_tokens.HTML: Technical acronym; style guide keeps Latin acronyms uppercase (ui.chat.canonical.supplement.preview_unavailable).
